# Jim Tsipoutas

> Jim Tsipoutas (Dimitris Tsipoutas) is Head of Product Design & UX, based in Athens, Greece, with 20+ years across digital products, UX, visual design and design systems. He pairs design leadership with hands-on craftsmanship — framing, designing and building intelligent products alongside teams.

## What he does
Product direction, interface systems and AI-first products: the framing that decides what to build, the design system that keeps it coherent, and the engineering that gets it shipped. Leadership by building rather than by slide deck.

- Product direction and framing.
- Interface systems and design principles at scale.
- AI-first products, designed and built end to end.
- Design leadership embedded with teams.

## Available for
Design leadership, consulting and fractional work with teams building intelligent products.

## Work
Founder of [The Last Click](https://thelastclick.gr), where the products live: Padlboard (padel scoring for Apple Watch and iPhone), BoomBoats (a voxel iPhone game), Cookonomics (food costing) and FlexUI (an API-driven design system for AI coding tools).

## Contact
hello@jimtsipoutas.com — the contact form on the site reaches the same inbox.

## Case studies
- [One system, seventeen markets — pawabloX](https://jimtsipoutas.com/work/pawablox/): rebuilding a fragmented design stack into one system shared by Design, Engineering, Front-End, QA and Research at betPawa across 17 African markets, then moving it into Claude Design so anyone in the company can prototype on the real components. Four months later dark theme shipped as one release instead of a months-long retrofit.
- [Speed, without guessing — pawaTech operating model](https://jimtsipoutas.com/work/speed-to-market/): AI embedded at the two points that govern speed to market — product people building their own prototypes on the real design system with Claude, and every idea validated with real customers then released to a small live cluster before it reaches everyone.
- [UX problems, on the record — pawaTech UX review](https://jimtsipoutas.com/work/ux-audit/): a Claude agent walks every journey on the live product against the Laws of UX, logging what works alongside what does not, so a full-product review takes days rather than a quarter and comes out as a severity-ranked UX roadmap the teams work through together.
- [Design that survived growth — Kaizen Gaming](https://jimtsipoutas.com/work/kaizen/): seven years at Kaizen Gaming (Stoiximan / Betano), taking design from a small team to a mature multi-team function with structure, standards, critique rituals and career expectations.
- [Idea to App Store, with agents — PadlBoard](https://jimtsipoutas.com/work/padlboard/): a padel scoring app taken to the App Store by directing AI agents step by step, across iPhone, Apple Watch and web — including a mid-flight backend rebuild from Supabase to Cloudflare Workers and D1.
- [A world built by script — BoomBoats](https://jimtsipoutas.com/work/boomboats/): a voxel naval battler on the App Store, with every ship, island and trophy generated by script and real-time 1v1 running peer-to-peer with no backend.
- [A game in four days — TinyDerby](https://jimtsipoutas.com/work/tinyderby/): a flick-football game built in four days, with every decision logged alongside its consequence.
